Plasma physics research has led to breakthroughs in materials science, resulting in more durable alloys for industrial applications. Fusion experiments have also advanced computational modeling techniques that are applied in weather forecasting and climate science. The iritic nature of these cross-disciplinary innovations demonstrates how fundamental science drives practical progress. These examples illustrate the broader societal impact of fusion research investments.
